verdict.rationale: Snyk's evidence pack covers SAST, SCA, container, IaC, and AI-assisted remediation but contains no mention of secret detection at all, let alone verifying detected secrets against issuing services to determine liveness. This capability (live-secret validation) is a distinct axis from Snyk's documented product lines, and no evidence indicates it exists. Missing for 10: any mention of secret scanning, any documentation of live/validity checks against issuing services (e.g., calling GitHub/AWS APIs to confirm a token is active).
